---
title: Numbered output regression fixture
format:
  html:
    fig-cap-location: top
filters:
  - path: ../../filters/numbered-outputs.lua
    at: pre-ast
crossref:
  lst-title: Code
  lst-prefix: Code
  custom:
    - kind: float
      key: map
      reference-prefix: Map
      caption-prefix: Map
---

```{r}
#| label: hidden-setup
#| include: false
values <- 1:3
```

::: {#map-visible-points}

```{r}
#| label: draw-visible-points
#| lst-label: lst-visible-points
#| lst-cap: ""
#| fig-alt: "Three points with increasing values."
plot(values)
```

:::

::: {#map-hidden-points}

```{r}
#| label: draw-hidden-points
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Three points with decreasing values."
plot(rev(values))
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-bars
#| lst-label: lst-bars
#| lst-cap: ""
#| fig-cap: ""
#| fig-alt: "Three bars with increasing heights."
barplot(values)
```

::: {#map-interactive-points role="group" aria-label="An interactive map with two circle markers near London."}

```{r}
#| label: display-interactive-points
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "An interactive map with two circle markers near London."
leaflet::leaflet() |>
  leaflet::addCircleMarkers(lng = c(0, 1), lat = c(51, 52))
```

:::

::: {#map-animated-assaults}

```{r}
#| label: display-animated-assaults
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "An animated map of hourly aggravated-assault density in Chicago."
knitr::include_graphics("../../images/chicago_downtown_agg_assaults.gif")
```

:::

::: {#map-paired-points}

```{r}
#| label: draw-paired-points
#| filename: "example.R"
#| lst-label: lst-paired-points
#| lst-cap: ""
#| fig-alt: "Two panels compare increasing and decreasing point values."
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(values)
plot(rev(values))
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-existing-caption
#| filename: "R Console"
#| lst-label: lst-existing-caption
#| lst-cap: ""
#| fig-cap: "An existing caption"
#| fig-alt: "Three bars with decreasing heights."
barplot(rev(values))
```

@lst-visible-points produces @map-visible-points. Hidden code produces
@map-hidden-points, @map-interactive-points and @map-animated-assaults.
@lst-bars produces @fig-bars; @lst-paired-points produces @map-paired-points;
@lst-existing-caption produces @fig-existing-caption.

```{r}
#| label: interleaved-console-output
#| filename: "R Console"
#| lst-label: lst-interleaved-console-output
#| lst-cap: ""
values
sum(values)
```

@lst-interleaved-console-output should have one Code label and one anchor even
though knitr splits the source around the two console outputs.

```{r}
#| label: fig-paired-charts
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: ""
#| fig-subcap: true
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-alt: "Two plots compare increasing and decreasing values."
plot(values)
plot(rev(values))
```

@fig-paired-charts must resolve to one Figure number for the two-panel chart.
